metric_rows.definition: Distinct external people voluntarily reporting an attempt of the declared demo/version; deduplicate repeat commands per person. Exclude maintainer automation and CI. If permitted evidence cannot establish uniqueness, record UNKNOWN; do not collect identity to meet a target.
metric_rows.evidence: No selected or started operational pilot; empty scoped manual event ledger.

metric_rows.definition: Distinct actionable, rights-safe reports with version/command, synthetic reproduction and expected/observed behavior; deduplicate underlying problems. A confirmed product defect is not required. Stars, likes and acknowledgments do not count.
metric_rows.evidence: No selected or started pilot and no collected cohort reports.

metric_rows.definition: Distinct external contributors whose first scoped code/documentation issue change is accepted through ordinary review and verified default-branch delivery. Drafts, starter creation, maintainer automation and review revisions do not count.
metric_rows.evidence: No observed pilot cohort; public starter opportunities remain unimplemented.

metric_rows.definition: An eligible first contributor later delivers a separate accepted change for a distinct issue. Split commits or rework within the same contribution do not qualify. If linkage cannot be established from permitted public/consented evidence, record UNKNOWN.
metric_rows.evidence: No eligible first contributors in the unstarted scoped pilot; no denominator.

metric_rows.definition: UTC first substantive maintainer triage minus report timestamp; classify response human, automated or unknown. Exclude automatic acknowledgments; publish only aggregate sample scope.
metric_rows.evidence: No eligible scoped reports; no response is never zero seconds and no response SLA is selected.

metric_rows.definition: Actual separately authorized external submissions/invitations; prepared drafts and repository delivery are distinct.
metric_rows.evidence: EQ134 announcement remains UNSENT; this work authorizes no external posting/invitation.

pilot_decision.reason: No operational pilot, external submission or invitations selected/authorized. Public-contact placeholder is a later submission prerequisite, not missing input for current documentation delivery.
pilot_decision.continue: Finish only the already selected manual metrics/lessons/library receipt and ordinary exact-head review/delivery scope.
pilot_decision.change: Separate future human-learning evidence from automated engineering qualification; keep zero recorded scoped events distinct from UNKNOWN global usage.
pilot_decision.stop: No external posts, invitations, participant collection, reminders, automatic restart, trial rerun or growth commitment.
pilot_decision.future_pilot: Only a separate concrete owner decision may select an optional manually operated30-day pilot, with current channel/contact/artifact/rules, permitted evidence and one explicit continue/change/stop review. No timeline or reminder is created.
